title: Return-Risk Factor on Payment Deferral Charges
content:
On a payment deferral for Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, a return-risk multiplier follows the returned payments on the contract dated fewer than 12 whole months before the request date, as the loan history shows them.

| Returned payments in the 12-month window | Deferral charge |
|---|---|
| two or more | multiplied by the repeat-return risk factor, 1.5 |
| exactly one | multiplied by the single-return risk factor, 1.25 |
| none | taken as it is |

The multiplier acts on the deferral charge alone.

## Window boundary (hypothetical, request on 2026-05-31)

| Date of the return | Whole months before the request | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-06-01 | 11 | yes |
| 2025-05-31 | 12 | no |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Deferral charge 35.00, one return in the window: 35.00 times 1.25 is 43.75.
- Deferral charge 22.50, two returns in the window: 22.50 times 1.5 is 33.75.
- Deferral charge 25.00, no return in the window: 25.00.
